displayName.zh-CN: AI 供应商绩效评分与风险跟踪

description.en: Manage existing suppliers with an AI-assisted performance scorecard. Track delivery, quality, price, invoice matching and response time, with evidence and corrective actions.
description.zh-CN: 面向采购团队的供应商管理模板：统一评估已有供应商的交付、质检、合同价差、发票匹配和响应时间，让 Agent 整理证据、记录风险并跟踪改进措施。
description.es: Plantilla para evaluar proveedores actuales. Los agentes reúnen evidencias de entregas, calidad, precios, facturas y respuesta para detectar riesgos y seguir acciones de mejora.
description.fr: Modèle pour évaluer vos fournisseurs actuels avec l’IA : livraisons, qualité, prix, rapprochement des factures et réactivité. Suivez les preuves, les risques et les actions correctives.

agentPrompts: Compare our existing suppliers on delivery, quality, contract price variance, invoice matching and response time. Show the evidence behind each score.
Which suppliers pose the greatest supply risk, and how much annual spend is exposed?
Draft a corrective action for each at-risk supplier, with an owner, due date and supporting evidence.
Prepare this week's procurement review: score changes, contracts nearing renewal and outstanding actions.
